The company works with businesses to support automation, operational efficiency, and digital platform implementation.

about_short_description.short_description: Yeepeey is a technology company offering digital transformation, fintech, e-commerce, and business automation solutions.

product.name: E-invoicing Platform
product.description: A platform for SMEs and freelancers to generate, send, and track invoices with integrated payment gateways for automated collections.

product.name: ECommerce Omni-Channel Marketplace Application
product.description: An omnichannel eCommerce application that integrates multiple sales channels to unify inventory, orders, and customer data for a consistent shopping experience.

product.name: Point of Sale (POS) System
product.description: A customized, cloud-based POS system designed to meet the technological needs of retail businesses for sales and transaction management.

product.name: Customer Payments Digitization
product.description: An automation tool for managing invoices, customizing and automating payment processing, and cloud document management.

product.name: SaaS Recurring Payments Platform
product.description: A cloud-integrated platform for managing recurring payments in SaaS businesses, supporting implementation, user service, and growth tracking.

product.name: Fintech Money Transfer Applications
product.description: Financial technology applications that facilitate money transfers, managing cost, complexity, and efficiency for modern businesses.
